name: brand_kit_process_document
description: Start async PDF/text extraction for a registered brand-kit doc. Dedupes active/content-hash runs. Poll status; atoms merge server-side. @see guides_get('brand-kit')

document_id.description: Sqid of a PDF/text document already registered via brand_kit_add_document.

document_ids.description: Batch of up to 10 doc sqids; prefer over document_id for several docs, then poll once with all run_ids.

force.description: Bypass content-hash cache only when user asks to re-extract.
